Human Infra waiting papers must bind K to a metric, worldline and reference observer.
sourceCards.supportedUse: Use to support proper-time differential terminology and reference-observer discipline.
sourceCards.falsifierUse: If a waiting scenario lacks metric, worldline or observer definition, classify it cannot-evaluate.
sourceCards.transferBoundary: Does not prove strong gravity waiting, artificial black holes, safe orbiting, exit, life support or recursive waiting.
risksAndMisreadings: Weak-field time correction can be overstated as strong-field feasibility.
Clock effects can be mistaken for subject-continuity benefit.
Reference-time ambiguity can hide model invalidity.
sourceCards.repositoryAction: Use as the physics Source Card for proper-time differential waiting terminology.
sourceCards.nextExtractionStep: Create a metric/worldline/reference-observer card template for future-waiting scenarios.

keyExtracts: Black holes provide a useful public context for strong gravity but not an engineering plan.
Event horizons and environmental hazards must block naive waiting-room interpretations.
Human Infra should keep 'black-hole waiting room' as metaphor unless formal scenario cards exist.

sourceIdentity.title: Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework (AI RMF 1.0)

sourceCards.oneSentenceUse: Use this source to anchor AI governance, risk framing and trustworthiness boundaries for AI-enhanced Human Infra routes.

humanInfraMapping.safetyBoundary: Risk-management framework support does not prove a specific AI tool is safe or beneficial.

modelPosition.stateVariable: AI tool and governance state variables.
modelPosition.stateTransition: Can structure governance transitions, not biological transitions.
modelPosition.hazard: Supports AI risk-channel language, not calibrated mortality hazard.
modelPosition.observationProcess: Requires monitoring, measurement and documentation of AI behavior.
modelPosition.actionPolicy: Frames governance policies, not individual advice.
modelPosition.timeAccounting: Can affect effective time through risk, friction and automation only with evidence.
modelPosition.optionValue: AI systems can expand or reduce option value depending on governance and failure modes.

keyExtracts: AI support must be governed by risk, measurement and accountability rather than capability slogans.
Trustworthiness and monitoring are prerequisites before AI is treated as Human Infra support.
AI can create negative channels: dependency, opacity, error propagation and governance failure.
sourceCards.supportedUse: Use to gate AI-enhancement, AI prediction and AI-assisted research claims.
sourceCards.falsifierUse: If an AI route lacks risk management, monitoring, human accountability or failure response, downgrade or block it.
sourceCards.transferBoundary: Does not certify any AI system, model, agent, dashboard or clinical decision support tool.
risksAndMisreadings: Framework citation can be mistaken for compliance.
AI capability can be mistaken for trustworthy subject support.
Governance overhead can be ignored in effective-time claims.
sourceCards.repositoryAction: Use as the AI governance Source Card for tool and model boundary gates.
sourceCards.nextExtractionStep: Create an AI route risk table covering measurement, monitoring, accountability, failure modes and human handoff.

humanInfraMapping.safetyBoundary: Normative health definition does not prove any intervention works.

modelPosition.stateTransition: No empirical transition imported.

modelPosition.actionPolicy: No action policy.

modelPosition.optionValue: Supports why social and functional conditions affect future choice.

keyExtracts: Human Infra should not reduce health to absence of disease.
Physical, mental and social dimensions are relevant to subject continuity.
A longer life with collapsed function or social support can fail the effective-life boundary.
sourceCards.supportedUse: Use to justify multidimensional health, function and social support outputs.
sourceCards.falsifierUse: If a route improves survival while destroying mental, social or functional support, downgrade it under effective-life boundaries.
